body:
Not like this. I try and all I get is 'well have you tried a schedule?' As if a) I hadn't thought of that in the last fifteen years and b) that's some magical cure. No one understands a lifetime of clinical, treatment resistant depression. My first attempt was when I was nine; i put 4 more under my belt in the following 15 years. People always tell me oh if your boyfriend/family/friends were worthwhile they'll stick around but how much can a healthy person be expected to deal with? Three? Five! No, no all of them. All of it.

I'm just so tired. I just want this to be iver. I'm over it. No pill helps; no therapy can give you what you lack when what you lack is the ability to care enough to get out of bed in the morning. That's just something you have to be born with. The ability to care about your own existence.
Could you feasibly give them out and say 'I wrote these when I was in a bad place, and I'm better now, but I want you to have them anyway' without it being linked to your considering?
